title: Interests
lead: Tell Bantoozi what you want to read about. Your cards shape what it shows you first.

strength.label: Strength
strength.hint: Must: matching articles always get top priority. Love and Like: matching articles rank higher, Love more than Like. Never: matching articles are hidden or pushed down.

mine.heading: My interests
mine.emptyBody: Add a card to say what you want to read about, or pick some from the library.

card.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from your interests. Articles are ranked without it from now on.

editor.name: Name (optional)
editor.examplesHint: Examples show what you do and don't mean. You can remove them from the card in My interests.

errors.interestRequired: Describe what you want to read about.
errors.interestTooShort: Describe it in at least {{min}} characters.
errors.tooLong: Keep this to {{max}} characters or fewer.
errors.characters: This text contains characters that can't be used.
errors.notSubscribed: You're no longer subscribed to that feed.

conflicts.alreadyHeld: You already have a card with this text, with a different strength, scope or name. Find it in My interests to change it.
conflicts.contention: This card changed while you were saving it. Try saving again.
conflicts.targetHeld: You already have a card with this text, but with a different strength, scope or name. Edit that card instead, or make its settings match first.

hints.heading: Writing a good card
hints.noNot: Avoid “not” in the main text; use the “but not” field
hints.noNumbers: Leave out dates and number limits such as prices, lengths or ages; freshness is handled for you

suggestions.heading: Suggestions
suggestions.lead: Cards Bantoozi thinks you might like, based on what you read and rate.
suggestions.emptyBody: Suggested cards appear here once Bantoozi has learned from your reading. You can also browse the library.

library.heading: Library
library.lead: Ready-made cards grouped by topic. Add the ones that fit what you read.
library.emptyBody: Try another topic or other words.

updates.heading: Library updates
updates.lead: Updates are never applied by themselves. Your card stays as it is until you apply one.
updates.applyNote: Applying switches this card to the new version. Your strength, scope and name stay as they are.
updates.privateNote: This card has your own changes or examples, so the update can't replace it. Customize it to review the new version against your changes.
updates.emptyBody: When the library publishes a new version of a card you hold, it appears here.
updates.kept_one: You chose to keep your current version of {{count}} card. It comes back only if the library publishes a newer version.
updates.kept_other: You chose to keep your current version of {{count}} cards. They come back only if the library publishes a newer version.

errors.privateHolding: This card has your own changes or examples, so the update can't replace it. Use Customize instead to review them.
errors.holdingMismatch: This card changed after the update was offered. The list has been refreshed.
errors.targetHeld: You already have the new version with other settings. Edit that card instead.
errors.gone: This update is no longer available. The list has been refreshed.

requests.heading: Publication requests
requests.lead: Bantoozi asks before one of your cards is listed in the public library. Each request shows exactly what would be published.

about.heading: How publication works
about.reuse: Reuse is not publication. If two people write the same card, Bantoozi can reuse it internally; that does not list it in the public library.
about.listing: A public listing makes the card findable in the library by everyone. It happens only for the exact card shown in a request.
about.version: Approving covers only the version shown. If the card's meaning changes later, it needs a new approval.
about.inactivity: An administrator may publish a card after at least 30 days in which you haven't used Bantoozi, unless you have declined. Coming back to Bantoozi starts that period again.

requests.changed: This request changed in the meantime. What you see now is its current state.
requests.emptyBody: If Bantoozi wants to list one of your cards publicly, the request appears here.
